Ibn Arabi said, "العبد رب و الرب عبد" or "al-`abd-u rabb-un wa-r-rabb-u `abd-un" (the slave is the lord and the lord is the slave)." Sufis claim that such statements were always considered to be the most elevated exposition of mystical thought in Islam, and therefore unsuitable for the untrained mind. Ibn Arabi has also said, "الرب رب في التنزل والعبد عبد في الترقى" or "ar-rabb-u rabb-un f? t-tanazzul-i wa-l-`abd-u `abd-un f? t-taraqq?" (The lord is a lord in his descent [to his creations] and a slave is a slave in rising). in Fusoos Al-Hikam" and "Al-Ahkaam. answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 36731 Country: India Title: Guide me to a Shaikh who can lead me in my quest of seeking Allah Question: Guide me to a Shaikh who can lead me in my quest of seeking Allah. Is there any one from the line of Shaikh Aqdas Gangohi. Will Maulana Talha Sahib of Mazahirul Uloom or Shaikh Salim Sahib of Deoband be the right person to contact in this regard? I want to reach "Martaba-e-Ehsan as soon as possible. Please help me. Answer ID: 36731 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 231/175/B=1433) Hadhrat Maulana Talha Saheb of Mazahir Uloom Saharanpur is a Sheikh whose chain reaches to Hadhrat Gangohi (رحمة الله عليه) and he would better for you. He is a God-fearing person. Consult him. As far as the matter of reaching to the status of Ehsan quickly is concerned it depends upon your hard work and struggle. As much struggle you would do and purify your inner self that much quickly you shall reach the status of Ehsan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
